description: Men's sleeveless Tunisian robe in cream cotton, gold silk embroidery on the chest (sfifa).
Winter jebba in light grey wool with a red-gold embroidered placket.
Hooded wool cloak with brown and cream stripes, worn over clothes in winter.
Traditional women's wrap in fine striped white silk with a golden border.
Festive dress in red velvet, gold embroidered bodice and hem (Mahdia style).
Red felted wool cap with a black silk tassel, hand made in the souk of Tunis.
Backless pointed leather slippers in saffron yellow.
Red leather balgha with gold stitching, for weddings and Eid.
Hand-woven cotton fouta with blue, white and red stripes and fringes; worn as a scarf or beach wrap.
Loose traditional trousers in cream cotton, worn with the jebba.
Woven alfa-grass basket bag with leather handles and wool pompoms.
Modern linen shirt with blue Tunisian embroidery along the collar.
